scoring.aggregate: Equal-weight selected three-task means; not a full benchmark leaderboard

fixed_rules: No new warmup or learning; frozen prior warmup experience reused byte-for-byte
Primary data use only new layouts2-5 with official eval_seeds0/1/2; old pilot is separate
Both arms use identical task/seed/layout and original native budgets
Frozen gpt-6.1-sol/high settings, controller code and EWAM weights
All valid failures retained; only infrastructure-invalid attempts may be retried after inspection
Each pair runs simultaneously on independent EWAM services; arms rotate across symmetric lanes
Per lane simulator and SAM share one H20; the two lanes have separate GPUs and model instances
No test outcome feedback into policy, memory, routing or controller
Fixed sample size72; no outcome-based early stopping or scene selection
No task/reward/observation changes or hidden object state access
implementation_differences_from_colleagu: Learned EWAM execution method added to the original RGB robot API and generated docstring reference
H20 GPUs and separate simulator / SAM3 / EWAM devices rather than colleague RTX4090 GPU3
Official OpenAI endpoint rather than colleague OpenAI-compatible gateway
Python3.10 EWAM runtime; Starlette version chosen for that interpreter, all installed versions retained
An additional seed2 layout0 episode per task; first two seeds remain 0 and 1
Additional host-only per-native-action state/action recording and three-camera videos, not additional policy observations

prior_variant.purpose: Frozen controller and warmup memory source; pilot scores excluded from primary analysis
